entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: W1C.CODE
entries.note: Bracket String to the Vector of codes: ( is 1, [ is 2, ) is -1, ] is -2.

entries.name: W1A.UNWORDS
entries.note: join a Vector of space-free Strings with single spaces ('' for empty)

entries.name: W1A.ARGMAX
entries.note: index of the first largest number in a non-empty numeric Vector

entries.name: W1B.R1
entries.note: one pass deleting adjacent () then [] pairs from a String

entries.name: W1D.PRESENT
entries.note: the non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order

entries.name: G0A.MOD
entries.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
entries.note: a b -> a mod b (floored), lifts over Vectors

entries.name: W1C.STEP3
entries.body: 'K' BIND 'X' BIND X 1220703125 G0A.MOD 'S' BIND X 1220703125 DIV FLOOR 'L' BIND S 5 DIV FLOOR S 5 MUL K 0 MAX ADD S 5 G0A.MOD K ADD 0 EQ SELECT 'S2' BIND L 1 SUB L 1 ADD S 5 G0A.MOD K ADD 0 EQ SELECT 'L2' BIND S2 L2 1220703125 MUL ADD
entries.note: FOLD/SCAN step on X = stack + 5^13 * count, the stack being base-5 digits (openers 1 or 2, unmatched closers 0); a closer pops when its digit matches.
